commentary.text: 90+6' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Maximillian Aarons (Valencia) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The game is interrupted. Joan Jordan (Alaves) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+4' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
90+3' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+1' It looked like the long-range shot by Sergi Canos (Valencia) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
90+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Here comes a substitution. Toni Martinez (Alaves) is brought on as a substitute for Kike Garcia.
90' Eduardo Coudet decides to make a substitution. Carles Alena will be replaced by Tomas Conechny (Alaves).
87' Ivan Jaime (Valencia) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
84' Substitution. Sergi Canos (Valencia) on for Mouctar Diakhaby.
84' Rafa Mir will be replaced by Maximillian Aarons (Valencia).
84' Eduardo Coudet prepares a substitution. Antonio Blanco is replaced by Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).
82' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
79' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Joan Jordan (Alaves) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Giorgi Mamardashvili no chance!
78' Luis Rioja comes off the pitch to be replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
77' Referee Jesus Manzano is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Alaves!
76' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
75' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) picks up a yellow card.
75' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Alaves!
74' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
74' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
74' The attendance is 17626.
74' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.

74' Ivan Jaime (Valencia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Alaves, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
73' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
72' Now Alaves have a corner.

72' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
69' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Facundo Garces (Alaves).
69' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
68' Maximillian Aarons (Valencia) picked up a yellow card from referee.
65' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ivan Jaime (Valencia) replacing Diego Lopez.
65' Today's match ends for Hugo Duro who will be replaced by Umar Sadiq (Valencia).
65' Substitution. Joan Jordan (Alaves) replaces Jon Guridi.
64' Rafa Mir (Valencia) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the goal. Poor header!
63' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) and Luis Rioja combine well with some one-touch passing and are gradually building up to an attack.
59' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.

57' Valencia slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
54' Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a good save to deny a long-range header from Carles Alena (Alaves). Great goalkeeping! The ball goes out of play and Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Alaves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
52' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
52' Luis Rioja (Valencia) works the corner short.
52' Luis Rioja (Valencia) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Valencia get a corner.
51' Alaves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

49' Jose Gaya (Valencia) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Alaves are taking a throw-in.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
43' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off his line to gather the ball. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.
41' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
39' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Giorgi Mamardashvili.
38' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
36' Alaves couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
36' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for an infringement. Alaves have been awarded a free kick.
33' Rafa Mir (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
32' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' Kike Garcia (Alaves) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
30' Alaves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
27' Luis Rioja (Valencia) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

24' A lofted cross from Jose Gaya (Valencia) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

22' Ander Guevara (Alaves) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails to the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a quick save to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
22' Alaves earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
21' Facundo Garces (Alaves) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

20' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili!
17' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) brings his opponent down. Jesus Manzano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Jon Guridi (Alaves) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
16' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Carlos Vicente (Alaves). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
15' Alaves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
14' Diego Lopez (Valencia) produces a header from long distance, but his naive attempt ends way over the bar.
12' The ball is cleared after Jose Gaya (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

11' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Valencia are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
7' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
6' Pepelu (Valencia) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Valencia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
4' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
3' Dangerous play by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves). Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.

2' Luis Rioja (Valencia) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Antonio Sivera sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Valencia will kick the game off.
